class.label: Concentrated-liquidity AMM tick-update and reinvestment paths desynchronize, double-counting liquidity

remediation.summary: Reconcile concentrated-liquidity tick state via a single source-of-truth path. Add invariant assertions that total liquidity at the active tick matches the sum of contributing positions before and after every swap/mint/burn. Fuzz-test contrived swap-then-mint sequences across tick boundaries.
